import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from sasviya.ml.assess import Assess


file_path = Path("./data/").resolve() / "hmeqscore.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
%set_env GRAPHICS_THEME=light

env: GRAPHICS_THEME=light

"""Test the assess classification attributes"""
assess = Assess(
    input="P_BAD1",
    y_true="BAD",
    pos_label="1",
    p_var="P_BAD0",
    p_pos_label="0",
    verbose=2,
)
assess.summarize(df)
